forecaster_note: Surf Guru read: A small but clean start to the week. A leftover dead-S groundswell (4.5ft @ 9s from 172°, ~237 kJ) is running under a glassy, near-windless morning — pretty faces everywhere but not much size. Direction's the catch as always: dead-south wraps soft into Dee Why and sits shadowed at Manly, so what size there is lives at the S-exposed banks — Long Reef rates best (fair-good, waist-to-chest, cleanest of the four). Time it: the 7:06am high drains to a 12:10pm low, so the mid-morning window is best before the banks go fat. Tomorrow goes tiny (knee-to-waist, ~26 kJ) but clean under a WNW offshore — a groveller day. The real payoff is Saturday: a powerful S pulse fills in (7.5ft @ 10s, ~980 kJ), well overhead at the S magnets. Surfline's Schaler Perry: 'Fun waves and still semi broken up, but slower than better SW-exposed regions. Light AM wind.' 🦈 SharkSmart's live feed is clear — no Northern Beaches shark detections in the last 24h, just SLSNSW drones patrolling as normal.

wind.summary: Glassy and near-windless through the morning — barely a breath of light N cross-breeze. Clean faces at every bank; make the most of the dawn-to-midday glass before any afternoon sea breeze fills in.

shark.summary: No shark alerts on the Northern Beaches (Palm Beach → Manly) in the last 24h. SLSNSW drones are patrolling the coast as normal.

tip.label: Frontside tip
tip.text: Dead-S 172° wraps weak into Dee Why, so set up wide on the Point where it corners into a rippable right. Glassy and forgiving today — shape over size, pick the sets and drive off the bottom turn.

tip.label: Frontside tip
tip.text: This is where today's size and shape live — cleanest banks on the S swell. Glassy faces, so pick the better sets and open up your turns. The everyday Inferno 72 is plenty of board.

tip.text: More exposed than Dee Why so it grabs the S — hunt the banked lefts on your backhand and stay high through the softer sections. Clean and glassy, just small.

manly.window: Smallest and most protected — knee-to-waist and glassy, but well under the other three on a dead-S. Not worth the drive over Long Reef today.

tip.label: Backside tip
tip.text: North Steyne stays tiny on a dead-S — soft, forgiving corners. Longboard or groveller for easy water time; otherwise chase the size up at Long Reef.

Sunday sits just beyond the 6-day window; early read is easing — re-check midweek.
